context: Asuka and Mei discuss a novel's themes.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: literature chat; vocabulary (運命/幸福/正義/才能/誤解) in natural home.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: この小説、運命の物語ですね。
lines.en: This novel is a story of fate.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 主人公は、才能に恵まれていますね。
lines.en: The protagonist is blessed with talent.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でも、幸福ではなかったですね。
lines.style: thoughtful woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 才能と幸福は、別のものです。
lines.en: Talent and happiness are different things.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 彼は、誤解されて孤独でしたね。
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 誤解の中でも、正義を信じました。
lines.en: Even amid misunderstanding, he believed in justice.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm reflective clarity throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最後に、運命を受け入れましたね。
lines.en: In the end, he accepted his fate.
lines.style: moved woman voice, soft warm tender delivery throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 正義を貫く姿に、幸福を感じました。
lines.en: I felt happiness in his upholding justice.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm reflective closing clarity throughout
